sources.note: No word-stress/accent statement. Section 8.5, p.233: 'Prosody is one of the domains in which the research on Kata Kolok is less developed at this point, and future research should be conducted...' Prosody is mentioned only for non-manual clause marking (conditionals), never word-level prominence.
